strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: tuna keybox awm mek chu Google-a revocation list (CRL) nen a check a, keybox dik tak a hmuh hma loh chuan source tam tak a try a, automatic backup leh Google services restart a awm bawk. Tap tinah a kal a, internet a mamawh (minute 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Network atanga keybox: official repository (GitHub) atanga keybox download a, /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. ah save internet a mamawh a, minute 1-3 vel a ni. Smart fetch a hlawhchham emaw, keybox manual a thlak emaw a hman thin.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: Remote Key Provisioning module awmsa te a check a, TEE attestation certificate version a enfiah a, KmInstallKeybox tool state a entir bawk. Engmah a tidanglam lo — device status view pangngai a ni.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): dumpsys atanga Widevine level indicator (L1/L3) te, DRM (IDM) key-file awmna, leh a kaihhnawih system property te a tarlang. Engmah a modified lo tak zet.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP siamthat: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual a kalpui. Automatic pass a chhiat chuan attestation issues a siam tha. Run apiang hian hlawhtlinna/hlawhchhamna line chiang tak a print thin.
strings.mdRkpFull: • RKP fix kimchang: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Hard cases te a handle a, hun rei zawk a daih bawk. A tawpah result chiang tak a rawn lang.
strings.mdGmsReset: • GMS reset: Play Store leh Google services (GMS+GSF) data a clear a, device chu a reboot nghal vek. Attestation rilru na tak atan chauh — i thlalak emaw file emaw a khawih ngai lo.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: device-a RKP certificate attestation state a check a, a tul chuan attestation properties chu a reset leh thin. User data a khawih lo.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER siamthat: device attestation nena inzawm Google services framework (SOTER) lama harsatna awmte a siam that. Play Integrity ai chuan SOTER rinchhan device thenkhat tan hman a ni.
strings.mdPifApply: • PIF hmang rawh: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force a kalpui. Fingerprint thlan (local/advanced) chu a apply a, pif.prop/pif.json files te chu a update thin. Log ah result chiang tak a rawn lang ang.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: engine installed state, fingerprint files (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), leh logs te a tarlang. Check chauh — engmah a modify lo.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: a kal sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. RKP certificate tih ngei ngei tur (February 2026) nena inmil theihna turin Canary Engine release thar ber a rawn la chhuak.
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), keybox files (active vs user), real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys te a check thin. Diagnostic display chauh a ni.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Keybox dahna tur (primary / secondary) a awm thei.
strings.hintKbSlots: Module hian keybox slot pahnih a enkawl a, chungte chu primary (sacred, never wiped) leh secondary (backup) te an ni. He tab hian eng slot nge active tih a tarlang a, preference a switch emaw, explicit request-ah secondary chu primary-ah a promote emaw a ni — backup leh full log nen.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: TEE key import, keystore2 chhunga library injection, revocation status (CRL), protection-list coverage leh RKP state te a check thin. Read-only — engmah a tidanglam lo.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• App install apiang atangin protection list chu siam thar leh vek a ni.
• Custom-ROM compatibility layer chu apply leh a ni.
• Active keybox chu apply leh a ni.
• Google Play services chu restart a ni.

Engmah a awm lo deleted a ni a, primary keybox chu a khawih ngai lo.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: primary leh secondary slot dinhmun a tarlang a, an inkarah duhthlanna a thlak danglam thin. Primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) hi venhim reng a ni a, wipe ngai lo. Secondary chu primary-a promote tur chuan chiang taka nemngheh a ngai a ni.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Secondary slot chu primary-ah promote rawh:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml chu primary slot content a lo ni ta a ni.
• Tuna primary chu thlak hmain backup atan save a ni.
• Engmah a delete lo — operation chu reversible a ni.

Continue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Secondary slot kha clear rawh:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml tihbo a ni ang.
• Primary slot a khawih lo.

Continue?
